title: Omnigent: a meta-harness that controls and combines tools like Claude Code and Codex in one place
description:
Running multiple AI agents just to get one job done? Omnigent is an open-source meta-harness that controls and combines tools like Claude Code and Codex in one place. Set strict budget caps, run agents in secure cloud sandboxes, share live sessions with your team. One command stands up a local agent server reachable three ways at once. Terminal UI, web UI, and your phone. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent
